Container.Name: codboz-online
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Play Online server for Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies ports (PS Vita, PortMaster, Nintendo Switch). Handles login, matchmaking and peer signalling; gameplay stays peer to peer. Uses host networking on purpose: players must be seen with their real addresses for peer-to-peer play to work. Point each game at this server with multiplayer_server=UNRAID_IP in its config.txt.
Container.Requires: Host networking. TCP 3074 and UDP 3478 must be free on the Unraid host; forward both from your router only if players join over the internet.

Config.Name: STUN address
Config.Description: What the server tells players its STUN endpoint is. 'auto' uses the Unraid host's LAN address (LAN play). For internet play use PUBLIC_IP:3478 and forward TCP 3074 and UDP 3478 to this host.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Player accounts (accounts.json). Back this up to keep accounts across reinstalls.

Config.Name: Max TCP connections per source
Config.Description: Per source IP (1-256). Each player keeps one lobby connection plus brief login connections; raise it when several players share one public IP.

Config.Name: TCP listen
Config.Description: Login and lobby listener. The games connect to port 3074; change only if you also redirect it.

Config.Name: UDP listen
Config.Description: STUN listener. The games use port 3478.
